name: An A-to-mid-B jump — clears the first leg, not the second
summary: Pairs a-to-low-b's 'ready-earned-upgrade' (a clean Ready) with low-b-to-mid-b's 'nearly-mid-pack-honest' (Nearly ready on the total alone, no gate, no rule — the ordinary case). Tests that the chain correctly moves its focus to the LATER leg once the earlier one clears, rather than staying fixed on the first leg.
